description: U2/U11 `worker_absent_freezes_accounting`: an exact fact whose write or fsync straddles the closure is not durable before closure; the notice is worker_absent at F; in the running core and after a restart no sealed or not_recorded fact and no extent with lower boundary at or above F counts, wherever it lies in the file; such lines are reported post-closure and non-authoritative; nothing settles the notice and no later C follows it.

instances.note: The closure notice at F (42, 8192), the frontier durable before closure. It is final for s1's accounting (#139).

An extent whose fsync straddled the closure: valid-shaped history with its own key, before or after the notice in the file. Its lower boundary is at F, so it never counts toward coverage; reported as post-closure and non-authoritative.
A sealed fact beside a worker_absent notice never counts toward completeness and never settles the notice, wherever it lies in the file.
For an entirely unrecorded session the worker_absent notice is the unrecorded kind (§5.7). It is final in the same way.
A not_recorded fact beside a worker_absent notice never counts toward completeness, wherever it lies in the file.
